2121997126897168622.en_summary: I’m starting to give more credence to the conspiracy theory that Jensen turned a blind eye to some of Nvidia’s advanced chips being smuggled into China. If he did, I think it was because he believed it was in Nvidia’s best interest. I don’t think Chinese spies got to him.
2121997126897168622.zh_summary: 我開始更相信陰謀論，即黃仁勳對英偉達一些先進芯片被走私到中國視而不見。如果他這樣做，我認為是因為他相信這符合英偉達的最佳利益。我不認為中國間諜影響了他。

2121996657617178740.en_summary: After a 50% move, AMD hit a broadening line and failed there two days in a row. Then a Wedge Drop: a gap down through the moving averages. That was enough to exit. +50%.
2121996657617178740.zh_summary: 在上漲50%後，AMD觸及擴大線並連續兩天失敗。然後是楔形下跌：穿過移動平均線的跳空下跌。這足以退出。+50%。
